[b]HAF SEAD[/b]

JA-35s and EA-18Gs are quickly scrambled to support the Wuloosyan operation. JA-35s using their advanced radars constantly search for any emissions from Rosenmarkke radars as the operation continues. Passively tracking and identifying different radars, the onboard systems are complemented by the RC-135 and SIGINT/ELINT satellites to create a comprehensive net for tracking Rosenmarkke SAM systems. Should the Rosenmarkke radar light up to try to carry out a shoot-down, the JA-35s would quickly respond with their long-range AARGM-ER anti-radiation missiles. The newer anti-radiation missiles would be built with shoot and scoot and blinking tactics in mind. If the Rosenmarkke systems rapidly turned on and off, the missile would continue to travel to its last emitted location while using its own radar in the terminal phase to intercept the target. 

B-25EXs and EA-18Gs assist the JA-35s in shielding the Wuloosyan strike package. From the stealth bomber several ADM-160 MALD-J drones are sent into Rosenmarkke airspace. Using its programmable payload, the ADM-160s modifies how it returns radar waves to look like Republik and Wuloosyan aircraft. Additionally, the J variant carries a jamming package that works to spot jam the specific frequencies of Rosenmarkke communications and radar. To further contest the Rosenmarkke radar, the EA-18Gs using their ALQ-99 pods flood radar frequencies to degrade their ability to detect as well as to reduce their detection range. Spoofing by the EA-18Gs works to create additional false targets on Rosenmarkke radar to make interception harder.

[quote=stuipendia;61415799]He looked up from his screen, taking a few moments to blink. Perhaps a sign of his growing screen time. In a moment, a smile grew across his face, and he rose, extending his human hand, he assumed it would be appropriate for the God-Worshipper to shake his human side. His appearance on any posters she saw along the way was remarkably similar, it was clear he did not attempt to hide his frailty. Though in his old age, he commands a nation of fifty million souls.

[b]"It is a pleasure to meet you, Keeper Agnieszka."[/b] The first sentence was in broken Corzerranean, he chuckled slightly. [b]"I did not have much time to brush up, this visit was a little sprung on me. I hope you understand."[/b]

He gestured towards the seat by her side, [b]"Please, sit. I am sure we have much to discuss."[/b][/quote]
Keeper Agnieszka nodded, smiling, and shook the Overseer's hand. She took a seat. [i]"Please, sir, the pleasure is mine."[/i]

She took a moment to be seated comfortably before proceeding.

[i]"If it is alright for me to ask, and I truly do not intend to offend you,"[/i] she began, [i]"may we began discussion with the mechanical arm you possess? I find it most intriguing."[/i]

[quote=corzerran;61415761]The twin guards followed behind Kain and Abel, carrying the luggage of the royal family, and Joshua followed behind his parents as the group moved forward through the doors.

King Zachariasz nodded in acknowledgement of Elena. [i]"It was no issue, all went smoothly. Once again, I thank you for hosting us in your nation."[/i]

Kain smiled. [i]"All has gone well, no worries on our front. The Empire is in good hands at the moment during the absence of the royal family."[/i][/quote]
Elena nodded, [i]"Good, good. You know how things can never cease, so I may be pulled for a meeting or two."[/i] She chuckled dryly.
She checked her watch and cleared her throat, getting the attention of the Family, [i]"The staff are preparing a light lunch now, it should be ready in maybe half an hour? Galina here will show you to where you'll be staying, and a member of staff will be present in the office at the end of the hall should you need anything. The table will be set in 40, if you choose to meet me down there. Feel free to roam, or ask the staff where things may be. I'll have a more formal tour for you once you're all settled."[/i]
She nodded curtly and began down the hall, into another room and out of plot relevance for now.

Galina led the family through the Palace's East Wing, to a set of double doors. [i]"This is Riverview Suite, it has big windows and good view of the river. Big, central sitting room with books, a porch, all nice things. I'll be in that office down the hall, can I get you all anything?"[/i]

She opened the doors, reavealing a gallantly decorated space. Landscapes from famous Elseyran painters, beautiful emerald curtains, and fine gold trim everywhere one could look. There were green couches and chairs built out of beautiful finished wood, with soft cushions and the occasional decorative throw blanket. The sitting room had not yet gotten so modern as to have a television, but it did boast towering oak bookshelves, full of publications in several languages from several centuries.

There were 6 bedrooms, a modest dining room, and a kitchenette. Four of the bedrooms were in the suite's loft, while the dining room and kitchenette sat opposite the bedrooms off the sitting room.

[quote=corzerran;61415761]As soon as she saw Elena, she rushed to her with a large hug. [i]"It feels like it's been so long since I last saw you!"[/i]

When she pulled away, she held her partner's hands in her own. Cecilia took on a grin of her own. [i]"I dropped from the skies. Special mission, they said. Pretty cool, right?"[/i][/quote]
[i]"From the skies? I really am loved,"[/i] She chuckled, [i]"It's cold out here, would you like to come in? The Royal Family arrived about ten hours ago."[/i] She opened the door for Cecilia and followed. Elena gave her girlfriend a quick kiss after hanging her coat up. [i]"Can I get you something before we join everyone? I think the night may be coming to a close soon."[/i] She smiled warmly, and her cheeks were flushed. Her braid was starting to show signs of giving out, and her squint gave away how tired she was.

[b]2028/3/9: First Election Polls[/b]

With the Parliamentary elections starting in a few months, and the Prime Ministerial election next year, Juan Sorobzaul Calieno-Ruiz and his Parliamentary Liberal Party arrive in shambles. Failure after failure, backtracking and the incompetence of the currently-reigning Liberal Parliamentary Party has tanked its reputation, evident with many polls showing a wave of new conservative representatives taking office later in the year.

After a section discussing the Lamandican Football Teams chances in the FEFA World Cup, Vyre News aired on television their first poll projections for the upcoming Prime Ministerial election. The numbers were detrimental for Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz, as he was shown to be the lowest of the top five candidates for the Prime Minister role in 2030, at an abysmal 6%. Labour-Conservatives Party member, and one of the most vocal opponents of Calieno-Ruiz, Quitford F. Boxeton was the most popular candidate, at 28%, with centrists Marissa Doange-Richinhare and Sanoald LBritirgintuint not far behind.

Shortly after this poll spreads throughout Lamandica, a disheartened Calieno-Ruiz announces that he will not run for reelection next year and that he will make a speech in the coming days to discuss the near-future of Lamandica.

[i][b]The Rise of Red Fear[/b]

Wednesday, 8 March 2028

The ongoing conflict between the United Commonwealth of Wuloosya and the Peoples Republic of Rosenmarkke has sparked intense debate within the Federal Techno-Democracy. What began as distant reports of regional clashes has now grown into a geopolitical conflict. For weeks, the Federal Assembly of the Grand House stood divided. With some demanding firm support for Wuloosya, others urging caution to prevent escalation, and a minority warning against any involvement at all.

580  YES (Support)
208  NEUTRAL
112  N0

The resolution has passed. The Federal Techno-Democracy will officially support the United Commonwealth of Wuloosya, but without direct troop deployment. The USO offers to send volunteer medical units and humanitarian specialists. In addition to material support, supplies, and logistical aid, as well as diplomatic backing on the international stage with the voice of IA to the embargo on Rosenmarkke aggression. 

Meanwhile, the USO has pushed public morale campaigns in support of anti-socialist and regime aggression. The USO has also pushed for expanded military exercises and a joint military base with EDU and even offered Wuloosya.
